description:
Standards behind the EUDI Wallet (OpenID4VCI, OpenID4VP, HAIP, SD-JWT VC, ISO/IEC 18013-5/-7 mdoc,
        Token Status List, ETSI profiles, ARF …): latest version at the publisher, the version the implementing
        regulations refer to, and the result of Eudigo's daily version check. Without `name` all standards are
        listed briefly; with `name` (id or abbreviation, e.g. 'openid4vp', 'HAIP') one standard in detail.
name: get_standard
title: EUDI Wallet standards and versions
